content.short: 3xpl is a fast multi-chain block explorer with ad-free browsing, blockchain APIs, and data tools for users and analysts.
content.description: 3xpl is a universal blockchain explorer built to make on-chain data easier to search, read, and reuse across major public networks, including TON. Its core product is a fast, ad-free explorer for transactions, wallets, blocks, and token activity, backed by tools aimed at heavier research workflows. The platform also offers PDF receipts and wallet statements, downloadable database dumps, JSON and WebSocket APIs, and a ClickHouse API for teams that need structured blockchain data for analytics, monitoring, or product development.
content.meta: Explore 3xpl, a fast multi-chain block explorer with ad-free browsing, APIs, PDF receipts, and TON support for data analysis.
